final:
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
  post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(5, 0) == 5
  ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  let v = int(x)
  let high = (v << k) % 256
  let low = v // (1 << (8 - k))
  (high + low) as u8
